title: Irish Potato Pie
description: A traditional Irish dish perfect for a cold winter evening. This warm and comforting potato pie is sure to become a family favorite.
instructions: Peel and chop the potatoes into 1-inch cubes. Boil in a large pot of salted water until tender. Drain and set aside.
Roll out the warm pie crust and place in a 9-inch pie dish.
In a large skillet, sauté the chopped onion and minced garlic in butter until softened.
Add the boiled potatoes, salt, and pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Pour the potato mixture into the pie crust.
In a small bowl, whisk together the milk and a pinch of salt. Pour the milk mixture over the potato mixture.
Bake the pie in the preheated oven for 35-40 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown.
Remove the pie from the oven and sprinkle with chopped chives. Let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
